label: No UI kit
$comment: Provides no frontend-components slot — there is no component library to document. It must still contribute the frontend-forms #ui anchor, because that anchor is not optional; it delegates to the framework's own plain_field, since plain markup differs between JSX and Angular templates and only the framework knows which it is. The react_/next_provider_* vars are empty fragments: the React main.tsx and Next.js layout.tsx always reference a ui-kit provider wrapper, so a plain project wraps the app in a no-op <> instead.
